reviews.title: Too many notifications
reviews.text:
The app is generally good, does what it says it will. But during even minor storms it’ll SPAM you with notifications.

For example we had a short 1-1.5 hour patch of rain and thunder and this app sent me at least 20 notifications during that time. Only half were accurate, and most were duplicates. This happens all the time.

reviews.title: Update rendered the app non-functional for iPad
reviews.text:
This used to be great but since completing yesterday's update it is not longer functional for my iPad. Extremely disappointing as I used it constantly

Not happy with the latest update, whilst it is still functional, the format is extremely clumsy on the iPhone and iPad making it difficult to read. Go back please!

reviews.title: Disgusting ads
reviews.text:
The ads on this app are just the worst of the worst. Today’s was a trick via a fake announcement about pensions to a fake ABC news site with an awful AI generated story about a politician getting arrested during a live show for disclosing a secret investment platform. It was so bad it was kind of amusing but also disturbing to think that this app is OK supporting this kind of fakery. 
I have deleted the app.
